==About==

A Waxing Toadstool is a Poisonous Mushroom which can be found in the wild or, with the [[Fungiculture]] skill learned, grown by planting another {{i|Waxing Toadstool}} in a {{i|Gardening Pot}}. When planting a Waxing Toadstool there is a chance for it to grow into a {{i|Spooky Redcap}} instead. When picking a Waxing Toadstool from the wild, if your {{i|Herbs & Sprouts}} Proficiency is high enough, you may detect that the Waxing Mushroom you just picked is actually the significantly more poisonous {{i|Waning Toadstool}}. Planting Mushrooms in Gardening Pots lowers [[Insanity]]. A Waxing Toadstool can be stored in a {{i|MushiSack}}.

When boiled a Waxing Toadstool will become a {{i|Boiled Waxing Toadstool}}. A {{i|Boiled Waning Toadstool}}, Boiled Waxing Toadstool, Waning Toadstool, and a Waxing Toadstool all count as a Waxing Toadstool when planting and in Food recipes.
